title: Autumn Assessment (AP1)
subtitle: Year 11 · OCR J277 · Original school assessment
notes: This original mixed-topic school paper is not an OCR examination or OCR past paper.
instructions: Show working for calculations and traces.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: State what the Program Counter (PC) and Memory Address Register (MAR) each hold.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain how cache improves performance when a program repeatedly accesses the same instructions.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: State one difference between RAM and ROM, referring to their purpose and volatility.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: A photographer needs a portable drive for large image files. Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of an SSD compared with a magnetic HDD.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Convert unsigned binary 10110110 into denary. Show a calculation.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Convert hexadecimal 3D into eight-bit binary, showing both four-bit groups.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Perform a logical left shift by one place on 00010111. Explain one change and state the eight-bit result.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: A bitmap is 80 pixels wide and 50 pixels high with 8-bit colour depth. Calculate its uncompressed size in bytes, ignoring metadata.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain why increasing colour depth while retaining the same image resolution makes the uncompressed file larger.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Give total after each iteration of the code and state the printed value.
parts.code:
total = 0
for i = 1 to 3
    total = total + (i * 2)
next i
print(total)

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: If total = total - (i * 2) replaces the addition, identify the error and explain its effect.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: A linear search seeks 9 in [4,6,9,2]. State the indexes checked, the found index and the number of comparisons.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain why binary search requires a sorted list.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: An IF condition below accepts the invalid score 105. Explain why.
parts.code:
score = 105
if score >= 0 OR score <= 100 then
    print("Valid")
else
    print("Invalid")
endif

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Write the corrected condition and give an accepted boundary value and a rejected invalid value.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: A Pupils table has fields ID, Name and Mark. Write SQL that returns only Name for pupils with Mark >= 50.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: State the names returned using the table provided.
